decisive_spans.text: Immunologic testing revealed an antinuclear antibody titer of 1:640, negative extractable nuclear antigen and double-stranded DNA antibodies, a rheumatoid factor of 62.29 IU/mL (normal <20 IU/mL), and an anti-cyclic citrullinated peptide antibody of 237.39 units (normal <20 units).

response.rationale: The presence of both rheumatoid factor and anti-cyclic citrullinated peptide antibody strongly supports Seropositive Rheumatoid Arthritis. While Mixed Connective Tissue Disease is considered due to the high ANA, the negative ENA and dsDNA make it less likely. The other diagnoses are less supported or contradicted by the findings.
